title: Mossy Waterfall Portal
description: A glowing white circular portal is embedded in a grey rocky cliff face, with a waterfall of green vines and water cascading down from it into a misty pool below. In the foreground, a large circular metallic platform covered in green moss and vines sits centered on the rocky ground, surrounded by silhouetted pine trees.
